Pressure pair forces (251-256), Monaghan 1992 viscosity (280-304) and tensile pair forces (259-277) ported with exact antisymmetric scatter; WVIS work booked as state.e_num in sph_step (cf. 519-521). Not carried: ELBUF_TAB fetch, group loop, PARTSAV. The conservation tests test_sph_pressure_forces_antisymmetric and test_sph_mass_conservation pass on structural grounds: the pair loop does add.at(forces,i,f_total) / subtract.at(forces,j,f_total), so F_ji = -F_ij and sum(F) = 0 hold for ANY f_total — including a wrong-magnitude one (the first two configs run vel = 0, so viscosity is off entirely). What they do pin: kernel/gradient correctness (separate tests), the repulsive sign, exact global momentum bookkeeping. What they do not pin: pressure/viscosity magnitudes, the EOS/material request (see the spstres.F and sphreq.F rows), or any missing state machinery (spreploc/splissv/spmall3).
